replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three independent experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states the cell death bar chart data represent mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, giving both n-number (3) and replicate type (independent experiments).

Panel B presents a quantified bar chart of cell death percentage, but the caption ('P19 cells were induced to differentiate as in Fig 3D, transfected and TCEs were analysed by wb as indicated.') gives no number of replicates or replicate type, and no error bars/n-number is stated anywhere in the panel or legend.

replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: The caption states the cell death time-course data are mean±s.d. of three experiments, providing an explicit n-number (3) and a replicate type (independent experiments).

Panel D shows a quantified bar chart of cell death with visible error bars, but the caption ('Mecp2-wt and Mecp2-null MEFs were transfected with the indicated proteins and analysed 40 h after transfection for cell death and protein expression.') does not state how many replicates were performed or what type of replicate (e.g., independent experiments) underlies the error bars.
